subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.------AF.DT.
description: Chart on book p. 174 (EVOL-12). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is the subject; AF-DT (affinity dictates) is the partner. From the subject: PER-DY (perception dynamics), TR (transformation) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From PER-DY: POST (postulation). From TR: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: COS-P (cosmic particulars) and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From AFI: PART (participation).
